thread:
Lena (Sales): Heads-up — customer (PayRail) wants BYO-CMK + multi-region HSM failover. Requirements: rotation <=5m, rolling swap w/ zero downtime, attestation, and per-op billing clarity. Can we list blockers before I reply?
Marco (Solutions): Quick clarifiers: do they need threshold signing? Which HSM vendor? Are they ok with DEK caching at the edge?
Lena (Sales): They said threshold preferred. Peak ~45k/min signing, want p99 <40ms. Also insisted on no plaintext key export.
Riya (CryptoOps): HSM-only signing at that scale + latency is unrealistic. Recommend KEK in HSM + ephemeral DEKs cached at edge (TTL 2-5m) and staggered rotation to avoid downtime. This cuts HSM calls by ~90-95%.
Riya (CryptoOps): Rotation flow: pre-generate new DEKs, switch traffic to new DEKs, keep old DEKs for a short grace window. Use wrap/unwrap via HSM for key material; HKDF derivation recommended.
Nate (Security): We'll need FIPS attestation, HSM operation audit logs, and a documented key export restriction. Also confirm zero-disk persistence of plaintext keys and provide evidence for SOC2/ISO items requested.
Marco (Solutions): Failover options: proxy to customer HSM (adds per-call latency & billing) OR provision a cross-region BYO sync (operationally intensive). Both require SOW acceptance.
Lena (Sales): Pricing question — how do we present HSM ops?
Marco (Solutions): Suggest reserved Dedicated baseline + per-proxied-HSM-op metering above baseline for BYO. For POC we can do metered dev calls and share an eval script to measure HSM-call reduction.
Riya (CryptoOps): I'll produce a small benchmark script (1000 ops, 50 concurrent) and a config snippet for firewall/curl test by EOD.
OpsBot: POC ticket created: POC-7719 assigned to Marco and Riya.
Lena (Sales): Great — I'll ask customer if DEK caching + the SOW fallback wording (not BYO-compliant) is acceptable. Thanks all :thumbsup:
